behaviors.behavior: Exclude-set filter semantics (Priority/Domain/Complexity: chip starts active, click excludes)
Two-level sort, primary+secondary independently asc/desc, over Domain/Name/Modified
Sort locale pinned to root/undetermined ("und"), not runtime-default ICU
Modified-sort uses latest-status-event ts, never originalTs (AC10)
Source-derived group subtitle dropped; flat list with Domain heading; 2-line detail excerpt retained
Hidden-count indicator whenever filtering hides an item (per-project + page-level aggregate)
Page-level all-filtered-out vs. genuine-empty distinction; denominator excludes promoted/dismissed items
Clear-filters button resets filters only, never sort; does not affect Parked-suppressed items
Parked filter: own independent toggle, default hidden
AC8 — a due parked item survives every active filter and is not counted as hidden
AC9 — a dateless park stays visible permanently, independent of the Parked toggle
Complexity filter: forward-compat shim, unrecognized wire values normalize to "unset", unset is a first-class filterable value
On-photo legibility: Deferred heading + AC7 hint use flipping --ink/--muted, not the legacy alias
